quotations.old_english: His módor, gífre and galg-mód, gegán wolde sorhfulne síþ
quotations.english: his mother, greedy and gloomy, would go a sorrowful journey

source_text: galg-mód; adj. [galg = gealh sad; mód mind] Sad in mind, gloomy; tristis an&i-short;mo :-- His módor, gífre and galg-mód, gegán wolde sorhfulne síþ his mother, greedy and gloomy, would go a sorrowful journey, Beo. Th. 2558; B. 1277. v. gealg-mód.
